flows.name: Record through a simulated interruption to a finalized, honestly-stated entry
steps: Open Record screen
Start recording, observe live waveform
Trigger a simulated interruption
Observe the ink-color/glyph interruption visual and VoiceOver announcement, not a spinner
Resume or finalize
Return to Timeline and see the entry with an honest transcribing/unavailable/ready badge, never a false 'ready'

flows.name: Tap-to-seek survives a transcript edit
steps: Open an entry with a ready transcript
Tap a mid-transcript sentence, confirm audio seeks to that point within tolerance
Edit the text of that sentence
Tap the same region again, confirm it still seeks correctly (via anchor ID, including nearest-surviving-anchor fallback if the anchor was spanned by the edit)

flows.name: Accept and dismiss tag/mood suggestions
steps: Open an entry with suggested tags and a suggested mood
Dismiss one suggested tag, confirm it disappears without being silently reapplied
Accept the mood suggestion, confirm it now reads as user-confirmed, not just AI-guessed

flows.name: Mention another entry and see a live backlink; delete and confirm no dangling link
steps: In an entry's transcript, @-mention a second existing entry via autocomplete
Open the mentioned entry, confirm a live backlink now appears
Delete the mentioning entry
Return to the mentioned entry, confirm the backlink is gone with no dangling or duplicate reference

flows.name: Search returns ranked, explained results
steps: Open Search tab
Enter a query matching both transcript content and a tag on different entries
Confirm results are ordered by the documented relevance score, not insertion or alphabetical order
Confirm each result shows a visible match-reason hint

flows.name: Demo entries toggle: seed, verify honest edge states, reverse cleanly
steps: In Settings, enable the demo-entries toggle
Confirm Timeline populates with seeded entries including a demo/real ribbon marker
Locate the seeded HealthKit-correlated day and the seeded broken-link example
Disable the toggle, confirm all demo entries and their mentions are fully removed with no orphaned backlinks

flows.name: Attach a PencilKit sketch to an entry
steps: Open an entry, add a sketch
Draw with finger or Pencil input
Save, confirm a thumbnail appears on the entry
Reopen the entry, confirm the sketch persists and reloads correctly

flows.name: HealthKit honest degradation when not authorized
steps: In Settings, view the permission matrix with HealthKit not yet granted
Open an entry from today
Confirm the HealthKit correlation card shows a hedged 'no data available' state, not a false 'not connected' claim, and does not block viewing or editing the entry
